sources.entry: Testpiler - Tool for converting XCTest test suites to Swift Testing.

summary.name: Testpiler
summary.one_liner: Testpiler is a native Mac app that converts Swift unit tests from the XCTest framework to the newer Swift Testing framework.
use_cases: Migrating an existing XCTest suite to Swift Testing
Previewing test code changes before applying them
Batch converting multiple Swift test files
Adjusting migration style such as @Test placement
summary.what_it_does: Testpiler lets you add a folder of unit tests or individual Swift test files. It shows a diff preview of proposed changes before you convert, and you can convert files one at a time or in a batch. Migration options let you control style, such as whether the @Test attribute goes on a new line and whether the "test" method prefix is removed or kept. The migration engine is built on the Swift compiler and runs entirely on-device, and the app includes no analytics.
notable: Migration engine built on the Swift compiler
Runs entirely on-device; source code not sent to servers
Configurable migration options such as @Test placement and test prefix handling
caveats: One-time purchase price; the page does not state a specific amount
Page says compatible with macOS 27 "Golden Gate" on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
